title: Penguin Solutions to Present at Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference
summary: Penguin Solutions, Inc . (Nasdaq: PENG ), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced that the company will present at the following investor conference: Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference 2026 at the Palace Hotel in San Francisco, Calif. Kash Shaikh, President and Chief Executive Officer, will present on Thursday, September 10 at 2:25 p.m. PT. An event webcast will be accessible on the investor relations section of the Penguin Solutions website at https://ir.penguinsolutions.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx and archived on the site for a period of 30 days. Penguin Solutions is the AI Factory Platform Company. We design, build, and manage next-generation data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers.


With deep design expertise at the intersection of data center AI infrastructure and memory solutions, our Full-Stack AI Factory Platform combines differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner technologies to help customers accelerate deployment, optimize token economics, and maximize the return on their AI investments.
